G2370358.description: Quinhamel is a city in Guinea-Bissau and the capital of the Biombo Region. It has a population of 2,887 (2008 est).

G2370776.description: Piche is a Sector in the Gabú Region of Guinea-Bissau. Piché is also a common last name.

G2371467.description: Mansôa is a town located in the Oio Region of Guinea-Bissau. Population 8,313 (2009 est).

G2371491.description: Mansaba is a Sector in the Oio Region of Guinea-Bissau.

G2371663.description: Boe (full name Madina do Boe) is a settlement in the southeastern Gabú Region of Guinea-Bissau. The population consists mostly of Fulani herders.

G2372532.description: Gabú is the largest city in eastern Guinea-Bissau, the second most populated city in the country and capital of the Gabú region.

G2372647.description: Farim is a town of northern Guinea-Bissau. It sits on the north bank of the Farim/Cacheu River, about 215 km (135 miles) up the river from Cacheu.

G2373526.description: Catió is a city in south-western Guinea-Bissau. It is the capital of Tombali Region.

G2373951.description: Canchungo is a town located in the western Cacheu Region of Guinea-Bissau formerly known as Vila Teixeira Pinto after Major João Teixeira Pinto, the Portuguese colonial officer who had brutally 'pacified' the area in the early 20th century. After independence the name was changed back to what it had always been.

G2374311.description: Cacheu is a town in northwestern Guinea-Bissau lying on the Cacheu River, capital of the eponymous region. Its population was estimated to be 9,849 as of 2008.

G2374583.description: Bubaque is one of the Bijagós Islands in Guinea-Bissau, and is also the name of its main town. The island has a population of 6,427, while the town of Bubaque has a population of 4,299 (2009 census).

G2374688.description: Bolama is the main town of Bolama Island and the capital of the Bolama Region. Though once the capital of Portuguese Guinea (now Guinea-Bissau), it has a population of just 4,819 (2009 census) and much of its colonial era architecture is in a state of severe decay.

G2374760.description: Bissorã is a town located in the Oio Region of Guinea-Bissau. Population 11,964 (2008 est).

G2374775.description: Bissau (; Portuguese pronunciation: [biˈsaw]) is the capital and largest city of Guinea-Bissau. As of 2015, it had a population of 492,004.

G2375254.description: Bafatá is the second-largest city in Guinea-Bissau, known as the birthplace of Amílcar Cabral. The town has a population of 22,501 (2008 est).
